mapper.select: SELECT * FROM spare_part_reservation WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM spare_part_reservation WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
SELECT * FROM spare_part_reservation WHERE status = 'RESERVED' AND expire_at < NOW()
SELECT r.* FROM spare_part_reservation r JOIN work_order w ON r.work_order_id = w.id WHERE r.status = 'RESERVED' AND w.status IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spare_part_reservation (work_order_id, spare_part_id, quantity, status, reserved_at, consumed_at, released_at, expire_at, release_reason, version) VALUES (#{workOrderId}, #{sparePartId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{reservedAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{releasedAt}, #{expireAt}, #{releaseReason}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE spare_part_reservation SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
